rationale: The platform is shifting from a dark/moody 'Jewel & Luxury' theme to a bright, sun-drenched, elegant Mediterranean style. This evokes a 'seaside villa' feel, building trust and conveying premium vacation experiences through natural light, terracotta warmth, olive hues, and crisp sand whites. We maintain the high-end appeal of Archetype 5 through sophisticated typography, generous spacing, and rich cinematic imagery.

colors.description: A light and luminous palette based on Mediterranean nature: creamy sand background, terracotta primary actions, soft olive/sage secondary accents, and deep charcoal/navy for highly readable text.

scale.overline: text-xs tracking-[0.2em] uppercase font-sans text-terracotta-600 font-medium

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing & The Bento Grid. Use p-8, p-12, p-16 to give elements breathing room. Implement Mode A (Tetris Grid) for marketing sections to build visual tension. Avoid 'Bootstrap' symmetry.

patterns.hero: Asymmetrical layout. Large cinematic image on one side or overlaid with bg-white/30 crystal glassmorphism for text readability. Heavy use of negative space.
patterns.property_cards: Flat design, no heavy drop-shadows. Sharp edges (radius-0) or maximum 4px (radius-sm). Thin 1px borders using var(--border) with subtle hover scale (-translate-y-1) and transition.
patterns.navbar: Sticky header. Uses 'Crystal Glass' approach: backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70, 1px subtle bottom border border-border/40. Allows scrolling content to blur beautifully underneath.
patterns.admin_dashboard: Mode B (Control Room). High density, use pure white cards on sand background. Sharp borders, dense tabular data layout, highly accessible forms.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-terracotta-600 rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-sans tracking-wide transition-all shadow-sm

inputs.style: Elegant thin borders. border-b-only or full thin borders (border-border). Focus states must use focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary focus:border-primary. No heavy thick rings.

badges.style: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground text-xs uppercase tracking-wider px-3 py-1 rounded-full font-medium

motion.philosophy: Elegant micro-animations. Nothing bouncy or overly playful.
motion.hover_states: Soft transitions (duration-300 ease-out). Subtle scales for images in cards (group-hover:scale-105).
motion.page_transitions: Smooth fade-ins and staggered list entrances via Framer Motion.

media.guidelines: Images must be high-res, showing Mediterranean architecture, natural light, and luxury interiors. Avoid generic AI slop. Keep hero overlay max bg-black/30 or use gradient to preserve image clarity.

iconography_and_libraries.icons: lucide-react (already installed) or @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight for luxury feel)

logo_guideline: Wordmark 'TerracitoAppartments' using Cormorant Garamond font-semibold, optionally accompanied by a minimal line-art sun or terracotta arch icon on the left.
testing: All interactive elements (booking buttons, admin toggles, filters) MUST include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., 'data-testid="book-now-button"').
